However, since the reduction in the use of steel and cast iron is only 0.018 percent of total steel and cast iron production, these latter impacts should be minor.
A 2.7 percent increase in the use of platinum and palladium used for NPA's is likely to result from the proposed AFES because of an increase in catalytic converter size. This increase in converter size will require an additional 2,200 troy ounces of platinum and palladium added to the 180,000 troy ounces estimated by EPA to be in use by 1990 as a result of their Revised Light Duty Truck Regulations for 1979 and Later Model Year Vehicles (40 FR 56316, December 28, 1976).
It is estimated that an additional 5.26 million pounds of plastics will be used as substitute materials for vehicle weight reduction. This is 0.025 percent of the total national consumption of plastics in 1975 of 21.2 billion pounds.
